events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the 86th birthday of the legendary Beatles co-founder, John Lennon, born in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their eponymous double album, widely known as 'The White Album'.

angles.name: White Album Classic
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. An iconic, eclectic masterpiece that still sounds fresh.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's passing, 35 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the music world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost a true showman. The voice and charisma of Freddie Mercury live on forever.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' – a pivotal album that pushed their sound into new, exciting directions.

events.title: John Lennon's passing, 46 years on
events.blurb: This day marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago, the world fell silent. Remembering John Lennon, whose music continues to inspire peace and love.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the visionary artist David Bowie, born in London in 1947.

angles.name: Bowie 80
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman, David Bowie, on what would have been his 80th birthday. Forever changing the landscape of music and style.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today, born in Mississippi in 1935.

angles.name: Happy Birthday King
angles.copy: Long live the King! Remembering Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. His legacy still shakes the world.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today, born in Heston, Middlesex in 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's iconic sound. What's your favourite riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer with the distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today, born in London in 1945.

angles.name: Rod the Mod
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, turning 82 today! Still rocking, still soulful, still a legend.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, the charismatic frontman of British ska band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Nutty Boy Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th to Suggs from Madness! Forever bringing that 'Our House' energy and making us all want to wear baggy trousers.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English pop and blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Wherever He Lays His Hat
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! Still got that blue-eyed soul magic.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today, born in Tennessee in 1946.

angles.name: Dolly's Day
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton! A true superstar whose talent and generosity shine brighter than her rhinestones.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer-songwriter, and TV personality Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today, born in Cheshire in 1971.

angles.name: Gary's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting legend, what's your favourite Gary moment?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams and into our ears with his timeless tunes.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's first induction, 41 years on
events.blurb: The very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1986, honouring pioneers like Chuck Berry and Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: 41 years ago today, rock history was made with the first ever Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony. Who was in that inaugural class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, singer and songwriter, celebrates his 55th birthday today, born in Oldham in 1972.

angles.name: Mark's Milestone
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From Take That to solo success, still got that boyish charm.
